gate_criteria_verification.criterion: G07: multiple matchers cannot double-assign, double-charge or lose committed entrants; current matching and charge timing remain unchanged.
gate_criteria_verification.no_double_assign: Two concurrent matchers racing the same actors produce at most one assignment and 0 double-seated players across 3 rounds
gate_criteria_verification.no_double_charge: Zero charges or reservations occur at queue offer or match creation time; reservations encumber only on second acceptance; void refunds exact contributions
gate_criteria_verification.no_lost_entrants: Every actor is either assigned, queued, or explicitly cancelled; un-paired candidates retain original FIFO joinedAt score
gate_criteria_verification.matching_policy_unchanged: Pure matchmaking policy from packages/domain/matchmaking.js identical to baseline; search windows, placements, latency, friends block, recent opponent, tournament cohort cap 200, and deterministic seeding preserved
gate_criteria_verification.charge_timing_unchanged: offerQueue sets OFFERED with escrow 0; first accept leaves OFFERED with escrow 0; second accept commits PLAYING and transfers equal contributions to escrow; void refunds exact balance
